{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted crew-neck knit top, cut to sit at the waist, deep emerald #0B6B4F, fine merino wool

A-line mini skirt, hitting a few centimeters above the knee, black #1A1A1A, leather-look matte fabric

Opaque tights, full length, black #111111, soft stretch microfiber

Cropped biker jacket, hip-skimming with a slightly cinched hem, burgundy #6D1A2B, grained leather

Ankle boots, rounded toe, low chunky block heel with a grippy lug sole, black #151515, polished leather

Chunky hoop earrings, medium size, silver #C0C0C0, brushed metal

Small crossbody bag, compact box shape, black #1A1A1A, smooth leather

Why this outfit works: the jewel-toned emerald against a burgundy jacket is a rich, unexpected color pairing that stands out in club lighting, and it flatters your dark hair, warm skin and deep brown eyes. The cropped top and jacket with the high-sitting mini skirt keep the proportions long and balanced, while the textured leather gives the rock edge the occasion calls for. The block-heeled boots are stable for standing through a long set, the jacket comes off easily when the crowd heats up, and the crossbody bag keeps your hands free. Everything stays neat and put together while still looking bold."}
